tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-26Let $(M,g)$ be a 4-dimensional Riemannian manifold. Given $p \in M$ and an orthonormal basis $(b_i)$ for $T_p M$, prove that the Weyl tensor at $p$ satisfies \[ W_{1221} = \frac{1}{3}(k_{12} + k_{34}) - \frac{1}{6}(k_{13} + k_{14} + k_{23} + k_{24}), \] where $k_{ij}$ is the sectional curvature of the plane spanned by $(b_i, b_j)$. \end{exercise}
